en.headline: Huanggang Port to hold over 100 drills including stress tests with 10,000 people
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the exercises, some jointly with Shenzhen, will cover traffic, anti-terrorism and systems before the redeveloped checkpoint opens.
body: The redeveloped Huanggang Port will undergo more than 100 drills, including large-scale cross-boundary stress tests involving at least 10,000 participants, before it opens, Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on Saturday.

Tang made the remarks after inspecting the Hong Kong Port Area with lawmakers. He said the drills would test traffic volume, anti-terrorism capability and mechanical systems. Civil servants will take part, similar to preparations for Kai Tak Stadium.

Renovation and facility adjustments are still under way. Extra manpower will be deployed in the initial phase after opening. Tang said the Hong Kong and Shenzhen sides would jointly decide the opening date once operations are judged smooth and safe, with both sides wishing to open as soon as possible.
Legislative Council President Starry Lee said the public is looking forward to the opening and called for contingency plans and early announcement of public transport arrangements.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸通關前將進行逾百次演練 壓力測試涉逾萬人
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，演練包括與深圳方面聯合進行的跨境壓力測試，涵蓋交通、反恐及系統等，確保運作暢順安全後才決定開通日期。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強星期六視察皇崗口岸港方口岸區後表示，口岸開通前會進行逾100次不同類型的演練，當中包括與深圳方面聯合舉行的大型跨境壓力測試，參與人數至少逾一萬人。
鄧炳強指，演練將測試口岸交通流量、反恐能力及機械系統等。公務員會參與測試，類似啟德體育園開幕前的安排。口岸仍在進行裝修及設施調試。
他表示，雙方會在確認運作暢順及安全後，共同決定開通日期，並希望盡早開通。初期會增派人手協助旅客。
立法會主席李慧琼表示市民期待口岸開通，並呼籲盡快公布交通配套安排及制訂應急預案。
